messages.text: ok so i'm looking at the worker loop right now
yeah. using `FOR UPDATE SKIP LOCKED` for the dequeue?
yep. works fine. but i have a question about the container networking
worker needs to hit ollama on the host right? since ollama isn't in the compose stack yet
exactly. i'm using `network_mode: host` for the worker service so it can reach localhost:11434 directly. feels hacky but i don't want to expose ollama to the whole bridge network tonight
fair. works on the gx10. just remember that breaks if we ever containerize ollama itself
noted. added a comment in docker-compose.yml so we don't forget
also what happens if the model call actually fails? like a timeout or whatever
right now it just sets status to 'failed' and moves on. no retry logic yet
so we get a bunch of failed jobs if the box hiccups for 5 mins?
yeah exactly. i'm thinking maybe a simple retry count column? bump it on fail, only give up after 3 tries
don't overcomplicate it for tonight. just log the error and let me know. i'll add a /retry-failed endpoint later if needed
ok good plan. also distinct states are 'queued', 'processing', 'needs_review', 'failed'. needs_review is for when confidence is low but not outright wrong
makes sense. i'll add a simple index on status for the worker to scan efficiently
